name: funnelzi Cart Recovery
author: ainextstudio

sections.description:
funnelzi Cart Recovery saves the checkout of a visitor who typed their email and gave their consent and, if the order is not paid, sends up to three reminder emails with a link that brings them back to the checkout of the same funnel.

It is an add-on for funnelzi, the funnel plugin that works without WooCommerce. Install and activate funnelzi first.

It works only with funnelzi. If funnelzi is not active, the plugin shows a notice asking you to install and activate it.

Built around consent. Nothing is saved until the visitor ticks the consent box of the checkout (the one you set for each funnel in funnelzi). You can turn the requirement off in the plugin settings if your legal basis allows it.

You decide the timing. Every delay is a number and a unit, from one minute to months: when a checkout counts as abandoned, when it counts as lost, how long after each email is sent, and how long the data is kept.

Features

  • Works with the checkout step of your funnelzi funnels.
  • Three ready-made reminder emails, switched off until you turn recovery on. Edit them, change the timing, add a coupon.
  • Emails with the picture, name and price of the product and a button that brings the visitor back to the checkout.
  • Optional single-use funnelzi coupon per email, percentage or fixed amount, with an expiry you choose, applied when the visitor returns from the link.
  • One-click unsubscribe link in every email, plus the List-Unsubscribe header.
  • Dashboard with checkouts captured, abandoned, recovered, lost, revenue recovered and recovery rate, and a view by funnel.
  • A checkout counts as recovered when its order is paid.
  • Activity log with the result of every email, clicks on the link, search, filters and CSV export.
  • Test email with sample data, and an option to send a copy to the site admin.
  • Exclude user roles, a never-email list of addresses and domains, UTM parameters on the link.
  • Personal data export and erasure through the WordPress privacy tools, and suggested text for your privacy policy.
  • Optional webhook for abandoned and recovered checkouts, and a weekly report by email.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate funnelzi.
  2. Upload the plugin and activate it, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  3. Open Cart Recovery in the admin menu, review the consent and the emails, and turn recovery on.
sections.faq:
Does it work without funnelzi?

No. It works only with funnelzi funnels. Without it, the plugin shows a notice asking you to install funnelzi.

Does it need WooCommerce?

No. It works with funnelzi, which has its own products, orders and checkout.

When is an email sent?

When a visitor typed their email at the checkout of a funnel, did not pay, and the time you chose for the first email has passed. A paid order stops all the reminders.

Does it work if the visitor never types an email?

No. Without an email address there is nobody to write to, and nothing is saved.

What happens when the visitor pays?

The order of funnelzi is paid, the checkout is marked as recovered (if a reminder was already due) and the scheduled emails are cancelled.

Are the reminders sent on time?

They are run by WP-Cron every minute. WP-Cron starts when someone visits the site; on a quiet site, a server cron that calls wp-cron.php every few minutes makes it exact.

Where do I get help?

Use the support forum of this plugin on WordPress.org.

short_description: Win back visitors who leave your funnelzi checkout without paying. Consent-first reminder emails, with timing you decide.
